set_channels_volume_db.description: Sets volume for one or more channels in the Channel Rack using decibels (dB). Channel Rack volume maxes out at 0dB (unity, normalized 1.0). Accepts either a single dB value for all channels, or a per-channel mapping. For relative changes, call get_channel_volumes first, calculate each target, then pass a mapping. Never interpret 'reduce by X dB' as 'set to X dB'. The default volume is -5.2dB.
